metadata.description: Safety and productivity mods for Claude Code, built for scientists.

plugins.name: auto-test
plugins.description: Runs the project's tests once at the end of a turn in which Claude edited files, and shows a green or red result. Off until you type /auto-test on.

plugins.name: big-file-guard
plugins.description: Saves tokens: when the model reads a large data or log file whole, it gets the first lines and a note, unless it asks for a range itself.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, DROP TABLE ...), shows exactly what they would destroy, and asks first. A safety net, not a permission system.

plugins.name: branch-janitor
plugins.description: Watches your git branches by itself (nothing to run) and notices when a branch's work is done (merged, squash-merged, pull request merged), even if you merged in a plain terminal. Checks it is safe to delete and offers to delete it. Never deletes without a click; the remote copy is a second, separate question.

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: A quiet usage line above the prompt that appears only when context, a plan window or a dollar limit needs a look, and an optional limit (plan-window used/total, or dollars for API-key use) that asks before the next prompt instead of refusing. Type /budget-guard for a short report.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Stops you once before a message that would re-write a cold prompt cache, shows the price, and can keep the cache warm with /keepwarm.

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: One-click safety snapshots of your working tree (untracked files too) that never touch your branch, index or stash. /checkpoint, list, diff, restore, drop. Restore shows what would be lost and asks first.

plugins.name: data-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a git commit or git add takes in large files, data files, personal-looking table columns or Jupyter notebooks with outputs. Only names are ever shown, never file contents.

plugins.name: diagram
plugins.description: Draws the last mermaid diagram from Claude's answer as box art in a pane: run /diagram to open it. Flowcharts, sequence diagrams and pie charts; offline, no model tokens.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: The project's file tree in a pane beside the chat, lit up as Claude reads, edits and commits files. Read-only.

plugins.name: long-run-ping
plugins.description: Pings you when a long model turn or a long Bash command ends, so you can look away: /long-run-ping [on|off|status|test].

plugins.name: moddeck
plugins.description: A side bar with a live Session box, a Side Question panel (/btw), every mod in grouped cards (a switch is the mod's name, green on and red off; click it to flip), the skills and saved prompts, and an update check.

plugins.name: prompt-library
plugins.description: Keeps your saved prompts, per project: /prompts add, use, rename, remove. The moddeck side bar shows them.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Turns your corrections ("no, use pnpm", "never do X") into rules you can save to CLAUDE.md with one click.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay steps through every file edit Claude made in the last turn (or the session), one diff at a time.

plugins.name: repro-log
plugins.description: Keeps a reproducibility recipe for data work: the analysis commands that succeeded and the files you changed. /repro writes it to .moddeck/repro/ with git commit, versions, lock files, seeds and a runnable command list. Secrets are never written.

plugins.name: review-cost
plugins.description: Before a git push triggers the automatic second-model review, shows its estimated token cost (green / amber / red) and lets you choose Review or Skip.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Live band and pane for Claude's plan tasks and subagents: task and helper progress bars, a subagent tree, tokens, est. cost, time and tool counts.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Keeps secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) out of the model's context: hides them in tool output and asks before a typed prompt that contains one is sent.

plugins.name: suggest-model
plugins.description: Checks every prompt locally (zero tokens). When the current model is likely too weak or overkill, it blocks the prompt and shows a dialog ("Don't use X for this task"), recommending the model with the best predicted fit per cost.

plugins.name: tool-skins
plugins.description: Restyles tool-call rows and Edit/Write diff cards in seven colour themes; /skin <theme> switches live.
